freePlan.limits: Unlimited drafts, UI kits and templates, 150 AI credits/day (max 500/mo)

keyLimits.en: Unlimited drafts, access to UI kits/templates, 150 AI credits/day capped at 500/month.
Unlimited files/projects, team design libraries, advanced prototyping, Dev Mode inspection, 3,000 AI credits/month.
Billed annually only; shared libraries across teams, centralized admin tools, 3,500 AI credits/month.
Billed annually only; custom workspaces, design system APIs, SCIM seat management, advanced security, 4,250 AI credits/month.

cautions.en: Organization and Enterprise seat prices are annual-billing only; no monthly-billing option is published for those tiers.
cautions.fr: Les tarifs Organization et Enterprise sont uniquement en facturation annuelle ; aucune option mensuelle n'est publiée pour ces paliers.

cautions.en: AI credits are capped per seat type (500/month for Dev and Collab seats regardless of plan tier), so heavy AI usage requires Full seats.
cautions.fr: Les crédits IA sont plafonnés selon le type de siège (500/mois pour les sièges Dev et Collab quel que soit le plan), un usage IA intensif nécessite des sièges Full.

capabilities.en: Vector-based interface design and prototyping with real-time multiplayer collaboration.
Reusable components, variables and design-system tooling shared across files and teams.
Dev Mode and Code Connect for translating designs into code and linking design systems to codebases.
AI design agent and Figma MCP server for AI-assisted design generation and coding-tool integration.

limitations.en: AI credits are limited even on paid seats and are further restricted for Dev and Collab seat types.
Several newer features (Figma Weave, Sites, Buzz, Motion) are still in Beta.
Cheaper seat discounts (Organization, Enterprise) require committing to annual billing.

reason.en: Overlapping use case for visual design, though Canva is broader and less focused on interface design.
Direct competitor in UI/UX design and prototyping tools.

unknowns: Whether Sketch remains listed as a current alternative in the catalogue was not verified (seed listed sketch under currentAlternatives but it was absent from the fetched alternativeCandidates pool).
